RECORDING_STORAGE_REFRESH_MILLISECONDS, requestRecordingPersistence, UNKNOWN_RECORDING_STORAGE } from '@/lib/recording-studio/recordingStudioCapacity';\nimport { chooseRecordingDirectory } from '@/lib/recording-studio/recordingStudioDirectory';\nimport { importStudioRecordingDirectory, readStudioRecording, recoverStudioRecordings, resetRecordingDirectoryCache } from '@/lib/recording-studio/recordingStudioStorage';\nimport { getRecordingSessionDuration } from '@/lib/recording-studio/recordingStudioSessionTime';\nimport { RecordingBitrateMeter } from '@/lib/recording-studio/recordingStudioTiming';\nimport {\n    type RecordingPersistence, type RecordingSource, type RecordingSourceConfiguration, type RecordingSourceReadiness, type StudioRecording,\n} from '@/lib/recording-studio/recordingStudioTypes';\nimport type { RecordingAlert } from '@/lib/recording-studio/recordingStudioAlerts';\nimport { useCallback, useEffect, useRef, useState } from 'react';\nimport { useRecordingStudioAlerts } from './useRecordingStudioAlerts';\n\nfunction getMutedAudioReadinessMessage(source: RecordingSource, configuration: RecordingSourceConfiguration): string {\n    const microphoneName = source.microphoneLabel || source.label;\n    return configuration.kind === 'camera'\n        ? `Mikrofon „${microphoneName}“ dočasně neposílá zvuk. Znovu připojte kameru se zvukem nebo výslovně vypněte Nahrávat zvuk.`\n        : `Mikrofon „${microphoneName}“ dočasně neposílá zvuk. Znovu připojte zdroj nebo vyberte jiný mikrofon.`;\n}\n\nfunction getMutedVideoReadinessMessage(source: RecordingSource): string {\n    return `Prohlížeč nebo systém dočasně neposílá obraz ze zdroje „${source.label}“. Záznam se při tomto přerušení zastaví; připojte zdroj znovu a potvrďte výběr v prohlížeči.`;\n}\n\nfunction getRecordingSourceReadinessMessage(source: RecordingSource, configuration: RecordingSourceConfiguration): string {\n    const videoTrack = source.stream.getVideoTracks()[0];\n    if (configuration.kind !== 'microphone') {\n        if (videoTrack?.readyState === 'live' && videoTrack.muted) return getMutedVideoReadinessMessage(source);\n        if (!videoTrack || videoTrack.readyState === 'ended') {\n            return configuration.kind === 'screen'\n                ? `Sdílené okno, karta nebo obrazovka „${source.label}“ skončila. Připojte zdroj znovu a vyberte jej v dialogu prohlížeče.`\n                : `Obraz z kamery „${source.label}“ skončil. Připojte kameru znovu nebo změňte výběr.`;\n        }\n    }\n\n    const isAudioRequired = configuration.kind === 'microphone' ||\n        (configuration.kind === 'camera' && configuration.isAudioEnabled);\n    if (isAudioRequired) {\n        const audioTrack = source.stream.getAudioTracks()[0];\n        if (audioTrack?.readyState === 'live' && audioTrack.muted) return getMutedAudioReadinessMessage(source, configuration);\n        if (!audioTrack || audioTrack.readyState === 'ended') {\n            return `Mikrofon „${source.microphoneLabel || source.label}“ skončil. Připojte zdroj znovu nebo vyberte jiný mikrofon.`;\n        }\n    }\n\n    return `Zdroj „${source.label}“ není připraven. Připojte jej znovu nebo změňte výběr.`;\n}\n\nexport function useRecordingStudio() {\n    const alerts = useRecordingStudioAlerts();\n    const [sources, setSources] = useState<RecordingSource[]>([]);\n    const [sourceConfigurations, setSourceConfigurations] = useState<RecordingSourceConfiguration[]>([]);\n    const [sourceErrors, setSourceErrors] = useState<Record<string, string>>({});\n    const [sourceReadiness, setSourceReadiness] = useState<Record<string, RecordingSourceReadiness>>({});\n    const [recordings, setRecordings] = useState<StudioRecording[]>([]);\n    const [activeRecording, setActiveRecording] = useState<StudioRecording | null>(null);\n    const [storage, setStorage] = useState(UNKNOWN_RECORDING_STORAGE);\n    const [persistence, setPersistence] = useState<RecordingPersistence>('not-granted');\n    const [directory, setDirectory] = useState<FileSystemDirectoryHandle | null>(null);\n    const [isChoosingDirectory, setIsChoosingDirectory] = useState(false);\n    const directoryReference = useRef<FileSystemDirectoryHandle | null>(null);\n    const directoryOperation = useRef(false);\n    const storageRequest = useRef<Promise<void> | null>(null);\n    const bitrateMeter = useRef(new RecordingBitrateMeter());\n    const [measuredBytesPerSecond, setMeasuredBytesPerSecond] = useState<number | null>(null);\n    const [pendingBytes, setPendingBytes] = useState(0);\n    const [phase, setPhase] = useState<'loading' | 'idle' | 'starting' | 'recording' | 'pausing' | 'paused' | 'resuming' | 'stopping' | 'unavailable'>('loading');\n    const [errorMessage, setErrorMessage] = useState<string | null>(null);\n    const [elapsedSeconds, setElapsedSeconds] = useState(0);\n    const runtime = useRef({ isDisposed: false, isAddingSource: false, isStartPending: false, capture: null as RecordingStudioCapture | null, sources: [] as RecordingSource[], sourceConfigurations: [] as RecordingSourceConfiguration[] });\n\n    /**\n     * Puts one announced failure where the administrator is already looking\n     *\n     * Note: A failure of one source reuses the very card and readiness state a disconnected source has when the studio\n     *       is idle, so a take which went on recording without that source still says so in one place only.\n     */\n    const showAnnouncedAlert = useCallback((alert: RecordingAlert) => {\n        setErrorMessage(alert.message);\n        const failedSourceId = alert.sourceId;\n        if (failedSourceId === null) return;\n        setSourceErrors((previous) => ({ ...previous, [failedSourceId]: alert.message }));\n        setSourceReadiness((previous) => ({ ...previous, [failedSourceId]: 'disconnected' }));\n    }, []);\n\n    const refreshStorage = useCallback((): Promise<void> => {\n        // A deletion/finalization may occur while a poll is in flight. Sample again after that older request.\n        if (storageRequest.current) return storageRequest.current.then(() => refreshStorage());\n        storageRequest.current = (async () => {\n            const estimate = await estimateRecordingStorage();\n            if (runtime.current.isDisposed) return;\n            setStorage(estimate);\n            if (!directoryReference.current && isRecordingOriginStorageLow(estimate)) {\n                void runtime.current.capture?.stop('Prohlížeč hlásí málo prostoru pro web. Všechny stopy byly zastaveny; uložené části zůstávají dostupné.');\n            }\n        })().finally(() => { storageRequest.current = null; });\n        return storageRequest.current;\n    }, []);\n\n    useEffect(() => {\n        const current = { isDisposed: false, isAddingSource: false, isStartPending: false, capture: null as RecordingStudioCapture | null, sources: [] as RecordingSource[], sourceConfigurations: [] as RecordingSourceConfiguration[] };\n        runtime.current = current;\n        if (!window.isSecureContext || !navigator.mediaDevices?.getUserMedia || typeof MediaRecorder === 'undefined' || !window.indexedDB || !navigator.locks) {\n            setErrorMessage('Studio potřebuje HTTPS (nebo localhost), snímání médií, MediaRecorder, IndexedDB a zámky prohlížeče. Otevřete ho v podporovaném aktuálním prohlížeči.');\n            setPhase('unavailable');\n            return;\n        }\n        let releaseLock: (() => void) | undefined;\n        const released = new Promise<void>((resolve) => { releaseLock = resolve; });\n        // One owner also prevents another tab from deleting or recovering an active take.\n        void runWithRecordingStudioLock(async (lock) => {\n            if (current.isDisposed) return;\n            if (!lock) {\n                setErrorMessage('Studio už je otevřené v jiné kartě. Zavřete ji a obnovte tuto stránku.');\n                setPhase('unavailable');\n                return;\n            }\n            try {\n                resetRecordingDirectoryCache();\n                current.sourceConfigurations = loadRecordingSourceConfigurations();\n                setSourceConfigurations(current.sourceConfigurations);\n                setSourceReadiness(Object.fromEntries(current.sourceConfigurations.map(({ id }) => [id, 'needs-permission' as const])));\n                const recovered = await recoverStudioRecordings();\n                const { clearRecordingExportTemporaryFiles } = await import('@/lib/recording-studio/recordingStudioTrim');\n                await clearRecordingExportTemporaryFiles().catch(() => undefined);\n                if (!current.isDisposed) {\n                    setRecordings(recovered);\n                    setPhase('idle');\n                    await refreshStorage();\n                    const result = await readRecordingPersistence();\n                    if (!current.isDisposed) setPersistence(result);\n                }\n            } catch (error) {\n                if (!current.isDisposed) { setErrorMessage(getRecordingErrorMessage(error)); setPhase('unavailable'); }\n            }\n            await released;\n            await current.capture?.stop('Stránka studia byla zavřena.');\n            current.sources.forEach(releaseRecordingSource);\n            current.sources = [];\n            // History navigation can unmount the page before an editor save or cancelled export settles.\n            await flushAdminSaves();\n        }).catch((error: unknown) => {\n            if (!current.isDisposed) { setErrorMessage(getRecordingErrorMessage(error)); setPhase('unavailable'); }\n        });\n        const storageTimer = setInterval(() => { void refreshStorage(); }, RECORDING_STORAGE_REFRESH_MILLISECONDS);\n        return () => {\n            current.isDisposed = true;\n            clearInterval(storageTimer);\n            void current.capture?.stop('Stránka studia byla zavřena.').finally(() => {\n                current.sources.forEach(releaseRecordingSource);\n                current.sources = [];\n            });\n            if (!current.capture) {\n                current.sources.forEach(releaseRecordingSource);\n                current.sources = [];\n            }\n            releaseLock?.();\n        };\n    }, [refreshStorage]);\n\n    useEffect(() => {\n        if (phase !== 'recording' && phase !== 'paused' && phase !== 'pausing') return;\n        const update = () => {\n            setElapsedSeconds(runtime.current.capture?.elapsedRecordingSeconds ?? 0);\n            setMeasuredBytesPerSecond(bitrateMeter.current.read());\n        };\n        update();\n        const timer = setInterval(update, 250);\n        return () => clearInterval(timer);\n    }, [phase]);\n\n    const chooseDirectory = async (isImport: boolean) => {\n        if (phase !== 'idle' || runtime.current.capture || directoryOperation.current) return;\n        directoryOperation.current = true; setIsChoosingDirectory(true); setErrorMessage(null);\n        // Invoke immediately while the native picker still has the click gesture.\n        const selection = chooseRecordingDirectory(isImport);\n        try {\n            const selected = await selection;\n            if (isImport) {\n                const recording = await protectAdminMutation(() => importStudioRecordingDirectory(selected));\n                setRecordings((previous) => [recording, ...previous.filter((item) => item.id !== recording.id)]);\n            } else { directoryReference.current = selected; {"type":"assistant","message":{"model":"claude-opus-5","id":"msg_011CfZXq6w25JFsas8HCRWpA","type":"message","role":"assistant","content":[{"type":"tool_use","id":"toolu_01TXFM6wpnAA9EVg4K3N7ZtL","name":"Write","input":{"file_path":"C:\\Users\\me\\work\\promptbook-experiments-and-landing-pages\\aldaron\\components\\recording-studio\\RecordingAlertPanel.tsx","content":"'use client';\n\nimport { Button } from '@/components/ui/button';\nimport type { RecordingNotificationPermission } from '@/lib/recording-studio/recordingStudioAlertNotification';\nimport type { RecordingAlertSeverity } from '@/lib/recording-studio/recordingStudioAlerts';\nimport { Bell, BellOff, Volume2 } from 'lucide-react';\nimport { useState } from 'react';\nimport type { useRecordingStudio } from './useRecordingStudio';\n\nconst NOTIFICATION_PERMISSION_LABELS: Record<RecordingNotificationPermission, string> = {\n    granted: 'Upozornění prohlížeče jsou povolená; výstraha dorazí i mimo tuto kartu.',\n    denied: 'Upozornění prohlížeče jsou zakázaná. Povolte je v nastavení webu, jinak zůstane jen zvuk a tato stránka.',\n    default: 'Upozornění prohlížeče zatím nejsou povolená. Bez nich uvidíte výstrahu jen na této kartě.',\n    unsupported: 'Tento prohlížeč upozornění nenabízí. Zůstává zvukový signál a tato stránka.',\n};\n\nconst ALERT_SEVERITY_STYLES: Record<RecordingAlertSeverity, string> = {\n    critical: 'border-red-300 bg-red-50 text-red-950',\n    warning: 'border-amber-300 bg-amber-50 text-amber-950',\n};\n\n/**\n * Shows every failure of the studio, and the two channels which announce one outside this tab\n *\n * Note: The test button raises a real alert through the real channels, because the only useful moment to find out\n *       that the sound is muted or the notification refused is before a recording, never during one.\n */\nexport function RecordingAlertPanel({ studio }: { readonly studio: ReturnType<typeof useRecordingStudio> }) {\n    const [isPermissionPending, setIsPermissionPending] = useState(false);\n    const isNotificationRequestable = studio.notificationPermission === 'default';\n    return <section aria-labelledby=\"recording-alerts-title\" className=\"space-y-4 rounded-xl border border-slate-200 bg-white p-5\">\n        <div className=\"flex flex-wrap items-center justify-between gap-3\">\n            <h2 id=\"recording-alerts-title\" className=\"text-xl font-bold\">Výstrahy při selhání {studio.alerts.length > 0 && <span className=\"ml-1 text-slate-400\">{studio.alerts.length}</span>}</h2>\n            <div className=\"flex flex-wrap gap-2\">\n                {isNotificationRequestable && <Button type=\"button\" variant=\"outline\" disabled={isPermissionPending} onClick={async () => {\n                    setIsPermissionPending(true);\n                    try { await studio.requestNotificationPermission(); } finally { setIsPermissionPending(false); }\n                }}><Bell className=\"mr-2 h-4 w-4\" />Povolit upozornění prohlížeče</Button>}\n                <Button type=\"button\" variant=\"outline\" onClick={studio.announceTestAlert}><Volume2 className=\"mr-2 h-4 w-4\" />Otestovat výstrahu</Button>\n                {studio.alerts.length > 0 && <Button type=\"button\" variant=\"outline\" onClick={studio.dismissAllAlerts}>Skrýt všechny výstrahy</Button>}\n            </div>\n        </div>\n        <p className=\"text-sm leading-6 text-slate-600\">\n            Selže-li cokoli během nahrávání, uslyšíte signál a dostanete upozornění prohlížeče, i když máte otevřenou jinou\n            aplikaci. Ztráta jednoho zdroje zastaví jen jeho stopu a ostatní nahrávají dál; celý záznam se zastaví, až\n            když nezbude co nahrávat nebo když selže ukládání.\n        </p>\n        <div className=\"flex flex-wrap items-center gap-5 text-sm\">\n            <label className=\"flex items-center gap-2\">\n                <input type=\"checkbox\" checked={studio.alertPreferences.isSoundEnabled} onChange={(event) => studio.changeAlertPreferences({ isSoundEnabled: event.target.checked })} />\n                Zvukový signál\n            </label>\n            <label className=\"flex items-center gap-2\">\n                <input type=\"checkbox\" checked={studio.alertPreferences.isNotificationEnabled} disabled={studio.notificationPermission !== 'granted'} onChange={(event) => studio.changeAlertPreferences({ isNotificationEnabled: event.target.checked })} />\n                Upozornění prohlížeče\n            </label>\n        </div>\n        <p role=\"status\" className=\"flex items-start gap-2 text-xs text-slate-600\">\n            {studio.notificationPermission === 'granted' ? <Bell className=\"mt-0.5 h-4 w-4 shrink-0\" /> : <BellOff className=\"mt-0.5 h-4 w-4 shrink-0\" />}\n            <span>{NOTIFICATION_PERMISSION_LABELS[studio.notificationPermission]}{studio.isAlertSoundSupported ? '' : ' Zvukový signál tento prohlížeč nepřehraje.'} Volby se ukládají jen v tomto prohlížeči a profilu.</span>\n        </p>\n        {studio.alerts.length === 0\n            ? <p className=\"text-sm text-slate-500\">Zatím žádná výstraha. Tlačítkem výše si ověřte, že signál i upozornění opravdu dorazí.</p>\n            : <ul role=\"log\" aria-label=\"Historie výstrah\" className=\"space-y-2\">\n                {studio.alerts.map((alert) => <li key={alert.id} className={`flex flex-wrap items-start justify-between gap-3 rounded-lg border p-3 text-sm ${ALERT_SEVERITY_STYLES[alert.severity]}`}>\n                    <div className=\"min-w-0 space-y-1\">\n                        <p className=\"font-semibold\">{alert.title}</p>\n                        <p>{alert.message}</p>\n                        <p className=\"text-xs opacity-80\">{new Date(alert.occurredAt).toLocaleTimeString('cs-CZ')}</p>\n                    </div>\n                    <Button type=\"button\" variant=\"outline\" size=\"sm\" onClick={() => studio.dismissAlert(alert.id)}>Skrýt</Button>\n                </li>)}\n            </ul>}\n client';\n\nimport { Button } from '@/components/ui/button';\nimport type { RecordingNotificationPermission } from '@/lib/recording-studio/recordingStudioAlertNotification';\nimport type { RecordingAlertSeverity } from '@/lib/recording-studio/recordingStudioAlerts';\nimport { Bell, BellOff, Volume2 } from 'lucide-react';\nimport { useState } from 'react';\nimport type { useRecordingStudio } from './useRecordingStudio';\n\nconst NOTIFICATION_PERMISSION_LABELS: Record<RecordingNotificationPermission, string> = {\n    granted: 'Upozornění prohlížeče jsou povolená; výstraha dorazí i mimo tuto kartu.',\n    denied: 'Upozornění prohlížeče jsou zakázaná. Povolte je v nastavení webu, jinak zůstane jen zvuk a tato stránka.',\n    default: 'Upozornění prohlížeče zatím nejsou povolená. Bez nich uvidíte výstrahu jen na této kartě.',\n    unsupported: 'Tento prohlížeč upozornění nenabízí. Zůstává zvukový signál a tato stránka.',\n};\n\nconst ALERT_SEVERITY_STYLES: Record<RecordingAlertSeverity, string> = {\n    critical: 'border-red-300 bg-red-50 text-red-950',\n    warning: 'border-amber-300 bg-amber-50 text-amber-950',\n};\n\n/**\n * Shows every failure of the studio, and the two channels which announce one outside this tab\n *\n * Note: The test button raises a real alert through the real channels, because the only useful moment to find out\n *       that the sound is muted or the notification refused is before a recording, never during one.\n */\nexport function RecordingAlertPanel({ studio }: { readonly studio: ReturnType<typeof useRecordingStudio> }) {\n    const [isPermissionPending, setIsPermissionPending] = useState(false);\n    const isNotificationRequestable = studio.notificationPermission === 'default';\n    return <section aria-labelledby=\"recording-alerts-title\" className=\"space-y-4 rounded-xl border border-slate-200 bg-white p-5\">\n        <div className=\"flex flex-wrap items-center justify-between gap-3\">\n            <h2 id=\"recording-alerts-title\" className=\"text-xl font-bold\">Výstrahy při selhání {studio.alerts.length > 0 && <span className=\"ml-1 text-slate-400\">{studio.alerts.length}</span>}</h2>\n            <div className=\"flex flex-wrap gap-2\">\n                {isNotificationRequestable && <Button type=\"button\" variant=\"outline\" disabled={isPermissionPending} onClick={async () => {\n                    setIsPermissionPending(true);\n                    try { await studio.requestNotificationPermission(); } finally { setIsPermissionPending(false); }\n                }}><Bell className=\"mr-2 h-4 w-4\" />Povolit upozornění prohlížeče</Button>}\n                <Button type=\"button\" variant=\"outline\" onClick={studio.announceTestAlert}><Volume2 className=\"mr-2 h-4 w-4\" />Otestovat výstrahu</Button>\n                {studio.alerts.length > 0 && <Button type=\"button\" variant=\"outline\" onClick={studio.dismissAllAlerts}>Skrýt všechny výstrahy</Button>}\n            </div>\n        </div>\n        <p className=\"text-sm leading-6 text-slate-600\">\n            Selže-li cokoli během nahrávání, uslyšíte signál a dostanete upozornění prohlížeče, i když máte otevřenou jinou\n            aplikaci. Ztráta jednoho zdroje zastaví jen jeho stopu a ostatní nahrávají dál; celý záznam se zastaví, až\n            když nezbude co nahrávat nebo když selže ukládání.\n        </p>\n        <div className=\"flex flex-wrap items-center gap-5 text-sm\">\n            <label className=\"flex items-center gap-2\">\n                <input type=\"checkbox\" checked={studio.alertPreferences.isSoundEnabled} onChange={(event) => studio.changeAlertPreferences({ isSoundEnabled: event.target.checked })} />\n                Zvukový signál\n            </label>\n            <label className=\"flex items-center gap-2\">\n                <input type=\"checkbox\" checked={studio.alertPreferences.isNotificationEnabled} disabled={studio.notificationPermission !== 'granted'} onChange={(event) => studio.changeAlertPreferences({ isNotificationEnabled: event.target.checked })} />\n                Upozornění prohlížeče\n            </label>\n        </div>\n        <p role=\"status\" className=\"flex items-start gap-2 text-xs text-slate-600\">\n            {studio.notificationPermission === 'granted' ? <Bell className=\"mt-0.5 h-4 w-4 shrink-0\" /> : <BellOff className=\"mt-0.5 h-4 w-4 shrink-0\" />}\n            <span>{NOTIFICATION_PERMISSION_LABELS[studio.notificationPermission]}{studio.isAlertSoundSupported ? '' : ' Zvukový signál tento prohlížeč nepřehraje.'} Volby se ukládají jen v tomto prohlížeči a profilu.</span>\n        </p>\n        {studio.alerts.length === 0\n            ? <p className=\"text-sm text-slate-500\">Zatím žádná výstraha. Tlačítkem výše si ověřte, že signál i upozornění opravdu dorazí.</p>\n            : <ul role=\"log\" aria-label=\"Historie výstrah\" className=\"space-y-2\">\n                {studio.alerts.map((alert) => <li key={alert.id} className={`flex flex-wrap items-start justify-between gap-3 rounded-lg border p-3 text-sm ${ALERT_SEVERITY_STYLES[alert.severity]}`}>\n                    <div className=\"min-w-0 space-y-1\">\n                        <p className=\"font-semibold\">{alert.title}</p>\n                        <p>{alert.message}</p>\n                        <p className=\"text-xs opacity-80\">{new Date(alert.occurredAt).toLocaleTimeString('cs-CZ')}</p>\n                    </div>\n                    <Button type=\"button\" variant=\"outline\" size=\"sm\" onClick={() => studio.dismissAlert(alert.id)}>Skrýt</Button>\n                </li>)}\n            </ul>}\n    </section>;\n}\n"}}}

getRecordingSelection, getRecordingUnavailableRanges } from './recordingStudioSessionTime';\nimport { RECORDING_MAX_PENDING_BYTES, type RecordingSource, type StudioRecording } from './recordingStudioTypes';\n\nconst STORAGE = vi.hoisted(() => ({ append: vi.fn(), save: vi.fn(), readPart: vi.fn() }));\nconst MEDIA = vi.hoisted(() => ({ inspect: vi.fn() }));\nvi.mock('./recordingStudioStorage', () => ({ appendRecordingChunk: STORAGE.append, saveStudioRecording: STORAGE.save, readRecordingPart: STORAGE.readPart,\n    createStudioRecording: async (recording: StudioRecording) => { await STORAGE.save(recording); return recording; } }));\nvi.mock('./recordingStudioMedia', () => ({ inspectRecordingBlob: MEDIA.inspect }));\n\nclass TestRecorder {\n    static readonly instances: TestRecorder[] = [];\n    static failStartAt = -1;\n    static isTypeSupported = (_mimeType: string) => true;\n    public state = 'inactive';\n    public mimeType: string;\n    public ondataavailable: ((event: { data: Blob }) => void) | null = null;\n    public onstop: (() => void) | null = null;\n    public onerror: (() => void) | null = null;\n    public start = vi.fn(() => {\n        if (TestRecorder.instances.indexOf(this) === TestRecorder.failStartAt) throw new Error('Synthetic recorder start failure');\n        this.state = 'recording';\n    });\n    public stop = vi.fn(() => {\n        this.state = 'inactive';\n        queueMicrotask(() => { this.emit('tail'); this.onstop?.(); });\n    });\n    public constructor(_stream: MediaStream, options?: MediaRecorderOptions) { this.mimeType = options?.mimeType ?? 'video/webm'; TestRecorder.instances.push(this); }\n    public emit(content: string) { this.ondataavailable?.({ data: new Blob([content]) }); }\n}\n\nfunction makeSource(id: string, isAudioIncluded = false): RecordingSource {\n    const videoTrack = Object.assign(new EventTarget(), { kind: 'video', readyState: 'live', muted: false, label: id, stop: vi.fn(), getSettings: () => ({ width: 640, height: 480, frameRate: 30 }) });\n    const audioTrack = Object.assign(new EventTarget(), { kind: 'audio', readyState: 'live', muted: false, label: 'Fixture microphone', stop: vi.fn(), getSettings: () => ({ deviceId: 'fixture-mic' }) });\n    const audioTracks = isAudioIncluded ? [audioTrack] : [];\n    return {\n        id, kind: 'camera', label: id, cameraDeviceId: '', cameraDeviceLabel: null,\n        microphoneDeviceId: isAudioIncluded ? 'fixture-mic' : '', microphoneDeviceLabel: isAudioIncluded ? 'Fixture microphone' : null,\n        displaySurface: null, displaySourceLabel: null, isCaptureEnabled: true,\n        isAudioEnabled: isAudioIncluded, microphoneLabel: isAudioIncluded ? 'Fixture microphone' : null,\n        stream: { getVideoTracks: () => [videoTrack], getAudioTracks: () => audioTracks, getTracks: () => [videoTrack, ...audioTracks] } as unknown as MediaStream,\n    };\n}\n\ndescribe('multi-source capture barriers and durable failure handling', () => {\n    beforeEach(() => {\n        TestRecorder.instances.length = 0; TestRecorder.failStartAt = -1; vi.stubGlobal('MediaRecorder', TestRecorder);\n        STORAGE.append.mockReset().mockResolvedValue(undefined); STORAGE.save.mockReset().mockResolvedValue(undefined);\n        STORAGE.readPart.mockReset().mockResolvedValue(new Blob(['encoded']));\n        MEDIA.inspect.mockReset().mockImplementation(async (_blob: Blob, track: { durationSeconds: number; kind: string; isAudioIncluded: boolean }) => {\n            const durationSeconds = Math.max(0.001, track.durationSeconds);\n            const components = track.kind === 'microphone' ? [{ kind: 'audio', firstTimestampSeconds: 0, endTimestampSeconds: durationSeconds }]\n                : [{ kind: 'video', firstTimestampSeconds: 0, endTimestampSeconds: durationSeconds },\n                    ...(track.isAudioIncluded ? [{ kind: 'audio', firstTimestampSeconds: 0, endTimestampSeconds: durationSeconds }] : [])];\n            return { firstTimestampSeconds: 0, availableStartTimestampSeconds: 0, endTimestampSeconds: durationSeconds, components };\n        });\n    });\n    afterEach(() => { vi.useRealTimers(); vi.unstubAllGlobals(); vi.restoreAllMocks(); });\n\n    it('starts/stops every source together and waits for the last data event and its disk write', async () => {\n        const onProgress = vi.fn();\n        const capture = new RecordingStudioCapture({ onProgress, onStopping: vi.fn() });\n        await capture.start([makeSource('one'), makeSource('two')]);\n        expect(TestRecorder.instances.map((recorder) => recorder.state)).toEqual(['recording', 'recording']);\n        let release!: () => void;\n        STORAGE.append.mockImplementationOnce(() => new Promise<void>((resolve) => { release = resolve; }));\n        const finish = vi.fn();\n        const completion = capture.stop().then(finish);\n        expect(TestRecorder.instances.map((recorder) => recorder.stop.mock.calls.length)).toEqual([1, 1]);\n        await vi.waitFor(() => expect(STORAGE.append).toHaveBeenCalledTimes(1));\n        expect(finish).not.toHaveBeenCalled();\n        release();\n        await completion;\n        const result = finish.mock.calls[0][0] as StudioRecording;\n        expect(result.status).toBe('complete');\n        expect(result.tracks.map((track) => [track.byteLength, track.chunkCount])).toEqual([[4, 1], [4, 1]]);\n        expect(STORAGE.append.mock.calls.map((call) => [call[1], call[2]])).toEqual(result.tracks.map((track) => [track.parts?.[0].id, 0]));\n    });\n\n    it('records a sound-enabled camera into one supported video/audio file and saves audio metadata', async () => {\n        const source = makeSource('camera with microphone', true);\n        const capture = new RecordingStudioCapture({ onProgress: vi.fn(), onStopping: vi.fn() });\n        await capture.start([source]);\n        expect(TestRecorder.instances[0].mimeType).toBe('video/webm;codecs=vp9,opus');\n        const result = await capture.stop();\n        expect(result?.tracks[0]).toMatchObject({ isAudioIncluded: true, audioSourceLabel: 'Fixture microphone' });\n        expect(result?.sourceConfiguration?.[0]).toMatchObject({ isAudioEnabled: true, microphoneDeviceId: 'fixture-mic' });\n    });\n\n    it('keeps each appended camera part\\'s audio setting when an explicit replacement is video-only', async () => {\n        const first = new RecordingStudioCapture({ onProgress: vi.fn(), onStopping: vi.fn() });\n        await first.start([makeSource('camera', true)]);\n        const original = await first.stop();\n        expect(original?.status).toBe('complete');\n        const second = new RecordingStudioCapture({ onProgress: vi.fn(), onStopping: vi.fn(), existingRecording: original! });\n        await second.start([makeSource('camera', false)]);\n        const appended = await second.stop();\n        expect(appended?.status).toBe('complete');\n        expect(appended?.tracks[0].parts?.map((part) => part.isAudioIncluded)).toEqual([true, false]);\n        expect(appended?.tracks[0].parts?.map((part) => part.frameRate)).toEqual([30, 30]);\n        expect(MEDIA.inspect.mock.calls.map((call) => call[1].isAudioIncluded)).toEqual([true, false]);\n    });\n\n    it('rejects reusing a source identity for another kind during append', async () => {\n        const first = new RecordingStudioCapture({ onProgress: vi.fn(), onStopping: vi.fn() });\n        await first.start([makeSource('camera')]);\n        const original = await first.stop();\n        const second = new RecordingStudioCapture({ onProgress: vi.fn(), onStopping: vi.fn(), existingRecording: original!, isSourceSetChangeAllowed: true });\n        await second.start([{ ...makeSource('camera'), kind: 'screen' }]);\n        expect(await second.finished).toBeNull();\n        expect(second.failureMessage).toContain('stejnou identitou');\n        expect(original?.status).toBe('complete');\n    });\n\n    it('rejects duplicate source identities before recording any data', async () => {\n        const capture = new RecordingStudioCapture({ onProgress: vi.fn(), onStopping: vi.fn() });\n        await capture.start([makeSource('camera'), makeSource('camera')]);\n        expect(await capture.finished).toBeNull();\n        expect(capture.failureMessage).toContain('duplicitní identitu');\n        expect(TestRecorder.instances).toHaveLength(0);\n    });\n\n    it('refuses to start a configured camera when its required microphone track is missing', async () => {\n        const source = makeSource('camera with missing microphone', true);\n        source.stream.getAudioTracks = () => [];\n        const capture = new RecordingStudioCapture({ onProgress: vi.fn(), onStopping: vi.fn() });\n        await capture.start([source]);\n        expect(TestRecorder.instances).toHaveLength(0);\n        expect(await capture.finished).toBeNull();\n        expect(capture.failureMessage).toContain('Požadovaná zvuková stopa mikrofonu');\n    });\n\n    it('falls through to a browser-supported MP4 audio/video codec combination', async () => {\n        vi.spyOn(TestRecorder, 'isTypeSupported').mockImplementation((mimeType) => mimeType === 'video/mp4');\n        const capture = new RecordingStudioCapture({ onProgress: vi.fn(), onStopping: vi.fn() });\n        await capture.start([makeSource('camera with microphone', true)]);\n        expect(TestRecorder.instances[0].mimeType).toBe('video/mp4');\n        await capture.stop();\n    });\n\n    it('stops and preserves the session when a required microphone track is muted', async () => {\n        const source = makeSource('camera with microphone', true);\n        const capture = new RecordingStudioCapture({ onProgress: vi.fn(), onStopping: vi.fn() });\n        await capture.start([source, makeSource('another camera')]);\n        source.stream.getAudioTracks()[0].dispatchEvent(new Event('mute'));\n        const result = await capture.finished;\n        expect(result?.status).toBe('interrupted');\n        expect(result?.errorMessage).toContain('přestal posílat zvuk');\n        expect(TestRecorder.instances.every((recorder) => recorder.state === 'inactive')).toBe(true);\n    });\n\n    it('interrupts a screen recording when the browser temporarily mutes its video track', async () => {\n        const cameraFixture = makeSource('VS Code on another Space');\n        const source: RecordingSource = { ...cameraFixture, kind: 'screen', displaySurface: 'window' };\n        const capture = new RecordingStudioCapture({ onProgress: vi.fn(), onStopping: vi.fn() });\n        await capture.start([source]);\n        const videoTrack = source.stream.getVideoTracks()[0] as MediaStreamTrack & { muted: boolean };\n        videoTrack.muted = true;\n        videoTrack.dispatchEvent(new Event('mute'));\n        const result = await capture.finished;\n        expect(result?.status).toBe('interrupted');\n        expect(result?.errorMessage).toContain('dočasně přestal poskytovat obraz');\n        expect(result?.errorMessage).toContain('nejde o běžnou pauzu');\n        expect(TestRecorder.instances[0].state).toBe('inactive');\n    });\n\n    it('stops all sources when a device disconnects', async () => {\n        const sources = [makeSource('one'), makeSource('two')];\n        const capture = new RecordingStudioCapture({ onProgress: vi.fn(), onStopping: vi.fn() });\n        await capture.start(sources);\n * @vitest-environment jsdom\n */\n\nimport {\n    appendRecordingAlert, createRecordingAlert, createRecordingTestFailure, DEFAULT_ALERT_PREFERENCES, describeRecordingAlertTitle,\n    getRecordingAlertSeverity, loadRecordingAlertPreferences, RECORDING_ALERT_HISTORY_LIMIT, saveRecordingAlertPreferences,\n    type RecordingAlert,\n} from './recordingStudioAlerts';\nimport { afterEach, describe, expect, it } from 'vitest';\n\nconst ALERT_PREFERENCES_KEY = 'promptbook-recording-studio-alerts-v1';\n\ndescribe('studio failures announced to an administrator who is not watching the tab', () => {\n    afterEach(() => window.localStorage.clear());\n\n    it('says whether the recording survived the failure, because that decides whether to run back', () => {\n        expect(describeRecordingAlertTitle({ impact: 'recording-continues', sourceLabel: 'App', message: '' }))\n            .toBe('Zdroj „App“ selhal · záznam pokračuje');\n        expect(describeRecordingAlertTitle({ impact: 'recording-stopped', sourceLabel: 'App', message: '' }))\n            .toBe('Zdroj „App“ selhal · záznam se zastavil');\n        expect(describeRecordingAlertTitle({ impact: 'recording-stopped', message: '' })).toBe('Nahrávání se zastavilo');\n        expect(describeRecordingAlertTitle({ impact: 'no-recording', message: '' })).toBe('Chyba nahrávacího studia');\n        expect(describeRecordingAlertTitle(createRecordingTestFailure())).toBe('Zkušební výstraha nahrávacího studia');\n    });\n\n    it('sounds the loud alarm only where something is no longer being recorded', () => {\n        expect(getRecordingAlertSeverity('recording-stopped')).toBe('critical');\n        expect(getRecordingAlertSeverity('test')).toBe('critical');\n        expect(getRecordingAlertSeverity('recording-continues')).toBe('warning');\n        expect(getRecordingAlertSeverity('no-recording')).toBe('warning');\n    });\n\n    it('describes one failure once for every channel which announces it', () => {\n        const alert = createRecordingAlert({ impact: 'recording-continues', message: 'Zdroj byl odpojen.', sourceId: 'screen-1', sourceLabel: 'App' }, 1_700_000_000_000);\n        expect(alert).toMatchObject({\n            severity: 'warning', title: 'Zdroj „App“ selhal · záznam pokračuje',\n            message: 'Zdroj byl odpojen.', sourceId: 'screen-1', sourceLabel: 'App', occurredAt: 1_700_000_000_000,\n        });\n        expect(alert.id).not.toBe(createRecordingAlert({ impact: 'recording-continues', message: 'Zdroj byl odpojen.' }).id);\n    });\n\n    it('keeps the newest failures readable without letting a flapping device grow without a bound', () => {\n        const alerts = Array.from({ length: RECORDING_ALERT_HISTORY_LIMIT + 5 })\n            .reduce<readonly RecordingAlert[]>((previous, _unused, index) =>\n                appendRecordingAlert(previous, createRecordingAlert({ impact: 'recording-continues', message: `Selhání ${index}` })), []);\n        expect(alerts).toHaveLength(RECORDING_ALERT_HISTORY_LIMIT);\n        expect(alerts[0].message).toBe(`Selhání ${RECORDING_ALERT_HISTORY_LIMIT + 4}`);\n    });\n\n    it('announces through both channels for an administrator who never opened these settings', () => {\n        expect(loadRecordingAlertPreferences()).toEqual(DEFAULT_ALERT_PREFERENCES);\n        saveRecordingAlertPreferences({ isSoundEnabled: false, isNotificationEnabled: true });\n        expect(loadRecordingAlertPreferences()).toEqual({ isSoundEnabled: false, isNotificationEnabled: true });\n    });\n\n    it('falls back to announcing when the remembered settings cannot be read', () => {\n        window.localStorage.setItem(ALERT_PREFERENCES_KEY, 'not json at all');\n        expect(loadRecordingAlertPreferences()).toEqual(DEFAULT_ALERT_PREFERENCES);\n        window.localStorage.setItem(ALERT_PREFERENCES_KEY, JSON.stringify({ isSoundEnabled: 'yes' }));\n        expect(loadRecordingAlertPreferences()).toEqual(DEFAULT_ALERT_PREFERENCES);\n    });\n});\n"},"caller":{"type":"direct"}}],"container":null,"stop_reason":null,"stop_sequence":null,"stop_details":null,"usage":{"input_tokens":2,"cache_creation_input_tokens":349,"cache_read_input_tokens":203330,"cache_creation":{"ephemeral_5m_input_tokens":0,"ephemeral_1h_input_tokens":349},"output_tokens":14,"service_tier":"standard","inference_geo":"not_available"},"input_transformations":[],"diagnostics":null,"context_management":null},"parent_tool_use_id":null,"session_id":"ddd17ca4-a901-4ebb-9ddf-2687bd18456d","uuid":"d20d04ef-d9e0-4f9e-bf1a-33eb5f7069c4","timestamp":"2026-09-30T11:22:23.216Z","request_id":"req_011CfZY7o2ij1TM3UYPj3PM8","wire_tool_inputs":{"toolu_01GTEbZEBTijGMyjzFUvq9q1":{"file_path":"C:\\Users\\me\\work\\promptbook-experiments-and-landing-pages\\aldaron\\lib\\recording-studio\\recordingStudioAlerts.test.ts","content":"/**\n Recording, storage, codecs and ZIP are real.\n        const streams: MediaStream[] = [];\n        const mediaRequests: MediaStreamConstraints[] = [];\n        const displayRequests: DisplayMediaStreamOptions[] = [];\n        const testSettings = { cameraAudioErrorName: null as string | null, displayErrorName: null as string | null, displayInitiallyMuted: false };\n        const MARKER_PERIOD_MILLISECONDS = 700;\n        const MARKER_DURATION_SECONDS = 0.24;\n        const MARKER_TIME_ORIGIN = performance.now();\n        Object.assign(window, { studioTestStreams: streams, studioTestMediaRequests: mediaRequests, studioTestDisplayRequests: displayRequests, studioTestSettings: testSettings });\n        const createStream = async (isVideo: boolean, isAudio: boolean) => {\n            const stream = new MediaStream();\n            let audioAnalyser: AnalyserNode | null = null;\n            if (isAudio) {\n                // Render real audio into a captured stream without connecting the fixture oscillator to speakers.\n                const context = new AudioContext();\n                const oscillator = context.createOscillator();\n                const gain = context.createGain();\n                const destination = context.createMediaStreamDestination();\n                gain.gain.value = 0;\n                oscillator.frequency.value = 880;\n                oscillator.connect(gain); gain.connect(destination); oscillator.start();\n                stream.addTrack(destination.stream.getAudioTracks()[0]);\n                // Observe the captured audio after the stream destination. Browser load can delay its samples\n                // relative to the wall clock, so the visual pulse must follow this signal rather than a timer.\n                audioAnalyser = context.createAnalyser();\n                audioAnalyser.fftSize = 256;\n                context.createMediaStreamSource(destination.stream).connect(audioAnalyser);\n                await context.resume();\n                const elapsedSeconds = (performance.now() - MARKER_TIME_ORIGIN) / 1000;\n                const audioTimeAtOrigin = context.currentTime - elapsedSeconds;\n                const nextMarkerIndex = Math.max(0, Math.ceil(elapsedSeconds / (MARKER_PERIOD_MILLISECONDS / 1000)));\n                for (let markerIndex = nextMarkerIndex; markerIndex < 100; markerIndex += 1) {\n                    const markerTime = audioTimeAtOrigin + markerIndex * MARKER_PERIOD_MILLISECONDS / 1000;\n                    if (markerTime < context.currentTime) continue;\n                    gain.gain.setValueAtTime(0.2, markerTime);\n                    gain.gain.setValueAtTime(0, markerTime + MARKER_DURATION_SECONDS);\n                }\n            }\n            if (isVideo) {\n                const canvas = document.createElement('canvas');\n                canvas.width = 320; canvas.height = 180;\n                const context = canvas.getContext('2d')!;\n                const audioLevelSamples = new Float32Array(256);\n                const draw = () => {\n                    let isMarkerVisible: boolean;\n                    if (audioAnalyser) {\n                        audioAnalyser.getFloatTimeDomainData(audioLevelSamples);\n                        isMarkerVisible = audioLevelSamples.some((sample) => Math.abs(sample) > 0.04);\n                    } else {\n                        isMarkerVisible = (performance.now() - MARKER_TIME_ORIGIN) % MARKER_PERIOD_MILLISECONDS < MARKER_DURATION_SECONDS * 1000;\n                    }\n                    context.fillStyle = isMarkerVisible ? '#fff' : '#102030';\n                    context.fillRect(0, 0, 320, 180);\n                    context.fillStyle = '#fff'; context.font = '24px sans-serif';\n                    context.fillText(String(performance.now()), 20, 90);\n                };\n                draw();\n                const interval = setInterval(draw, 33);\n                const videoTrack = canvas.captureStream(30).getVideoTracks()[0];\n                videoTrack.addEventListener('ended', () => clearInterval(interval));\n                stream.addTrack(videoTrack);\n            }\n            streams.push(stream);\n            return stream;\n        };\n        Object.defineProperties(navigator.mediaDevices, {\n            getUserMedia: { value: (constraints: MediaStreamConstraints) => {\n                mediaRequests.push(constraints);","is_error":false}]},"parent_tool_use_id":null,"session_id":"ddd17ca4-a901-4ebb-9ddf-2687bd18456d","uuid":"1539d8a1-d712-4f90-9a75-790a95251be9","timestamp":"2026-09-30T11:27:39.824Z","tool_use_result":{"stdout":"import recordStudioNotifications(page);\n    await openStudio(page, baseURL);\n\n    await page.getByRole('button', { name: 'Otestovat výstrahu', exact: true }).click();\n    const alertHistory = page.getByRole('log', { name: 'Historie výstrah', exact: true });\n    await expect(alertHistory).toContainText('Zkušební výstraha nahrávacího studia');\n    await expect.poll(() => readStudioNotifications(page)).toEqual([expect.objectContaining({\n        title: 'Zkušební výstraha nahrávacího studia', body: expect.stringContaining('Nic se nepokazilo') as unknown as string,\n    })]);\n\n    await page.getByRole('button', { name: 'Skrýt všechny výstrahy', exact: true }).click();\n    await expect(alertHistory).toHaveCount(0);\n});\n\ntest('keeps the other tracks recording })).toBeVisible();\n\n    const recording = await page.evaluate(async () => {\n        const database = await new Promise<IDBDatabase>((resolve, reject) => {\n            const request = indexedDB.open('promptbook-recording-studio');\n            request.onsuccess = () => resolve(request.result);\n            request.onerror = () => reject(request.error);\n        });\n        try {\n            const recordings = await new Promise<StudioRecording[]>((resolve, reject) => {\n                const request = database.transaction('recordings').objectStore('recordings').getAll();\n                request.onsuccess = () => resolve(request.result);\n                request.onerror = () => reject(request.error);\n            });\n            return recordings[recordings.length - 1];\n        } finally { database.close(); }\n    });\n    expect(recording.tracks).toHaveLength(2);\n    expect(recording.tracks.every((track) => (track.parts ?? []).every((part) => part.byteLength > 0))).toBe(true);\n    // The lost source keeps only what it committed; the survivor carries the whole session.\n    const [cameraTrack, screenTrack] = recording.tracks;\n    expect(screenTrack.durationSeconds).toBeLessThan(cameraTrack.durationSeconds);\n    expect(recording.errorMessage).toContain('ostatní stopy nahrávají dál');\n});\n\ntest('blocks 'application/json' });\n});\n\nasync function openStudio(page: Page, baseURL: string | undefined) {\n    test.skip(!process.env.ADMIN_PASSWORD, 'Needs the local test server admin password.');\n    await page.context().addCookies([{ name: ADMIN_SESSION_COOKIE_NAME, value: createAdminSessionValueOrNull()!, url: baseURL!, httpOnly: true, sameSite: 'Lax' }]);\n    await page.addInitScript(() => {\n        // Only replace physical devices/the permission picker. Recording, storage, codecs and ZIP are real.\n        const streams: MediaStream[] = [];\n        const mediaRequests: MediaStreamConstraints[] = [];\n        const displayRequests: DisplayMediaStreamOptions[] = [];\n        const testSettings = { cameraAudioErrorName: null as string | null, displayErrorName: null as string | null, displayInitiallyMuted: false };\n        const MARKER_PERIOD_MILLISECONDS = 700;\n        const MARKER_DURATION_SECONDS = 0.24;\n        const MARKER_TIME_ORIGIN = performance.now();\n        Object.assign(window, { studioTestStreams: streams, studioTestMediaRequests: mediaRequests, studioTestDisplayRequests: displayRequests, studioTestSettings: testSettings });\n        const createStream = async (isVideo: boolean, isAudio: boolean) => {\n            const stream = new MediaStream();\n            let audioAnalyser: AnalyserNode | null = null;\n            if (isAudio) {\n                // Render real audio into a captured stream without connecting the fixture oscillator to speakers.\n                const context = new AudioContext();\n                const oscillator = context.createOscillator();\n                const gain = context.createGain();\n                const destination = context.createMediaStreamDestination();\n                gain.gain.value = 0;\n                oscillator.frequency.value = 880;\n                oscillator.connect(gain); gain.connect(destination); oscillator.start();\n                stream.addTrack(destination.stream.getAudioTracks()[0]);\n                // Observe the captured audio after the stream destination. Browser load can delay its samples\n                // relative to the wall clock, so the visual pulse must follow this signal rather than a timer.\n                audioAnalyser = context.createAnalyser();\n                audioAnalyser.fftSize = 256;\n                context.createMediaStreamSource(destination.stream).connect(audioAnalyser);\n                await context.resume();\n                const elapsedSeconds = (performance.now() - MARKER_TIME_ORIGIN) / 1000;\n                const audioTimeAtOrigin = context.currentTime - elapsedSeconds;\n                const nextMarkerIndex = Math.max(0, Math.ceil(elapsedSeconds / (MARKER_PERIOD_MILLISECONDS / 1000)));\n                for (let markerIndex = nextMarkerIndex; markerIndex < 100; markerIndex += 1) {\n                    const markerTime = audioTimeAtOrigin + markerIndex * MARKER_PERIOD_MILLISECONDS / 1000;\n                    if (markerTime < context.currentTime) continue;\n                    gain.gain.setValueAtTime(0.2, markerTime);\n                    gain.gain.setValueAtTime(0, markerTime + MARKER_DURATION_SECONDS);\n                }\n            }\n            if (isVideo) {\n                const canvas = document.createElement('canvas');\n                canvas.width = 320; canvas.height = 180;\n                const context = canvas.getContext('2d')!;\n                const audioLevelSamples = new Float32Array(256);\n                const draw = () => {\n                    let isMarkerVisible: boolean;\n                    if (audioAnalyser) {\n                        audioAnalyser.getFloatTimeDomainData(audioLevelSamples);\n                        isMarkerVisible = audioLevelSamples.some((sample) => Math.abs(sample) > 0.04);\n                    } else {\n                        isMarkerVisible = (performance.now() - MARKER_TIME_ORIGIN) % MARKER_PERIOD_MILLISECONDS < MARKER_DURATION_SECONDS * 1000;\n                    }\n                    context.fillStyle = isMarkerVisible ? '#fff' : '#102030';\n                    context.fillRect(0, 0, 320, 180);\n                    context.fillStyle = '#fff'; context.font = '24px sans-serif';\n                    context.fillText(String(performance.now()), 20, 90);\n                };\n                draw();\n                const interval = setInterval(draw, 33);\n                const videoTrack = canvas.captureStream(30).getVideoTracks()[0];\n                videoTrack.addEventListener('ended', () => clearInterval(interval));\n                stream.addTrack(videoTrack);\n            }\n            streams.push(stream);\n            return stream;\n        };\n        Object.defineProperties(navigator.mediaDevices, {\n            getUserMedia: { value: (constraints: MediaStreamConstraints) => {\n                mediaRequests.push(constraints);\n                if (testSettings.cameraAudioErrorName && Boolean(constraints.video) && Boolean(constraints.audio)) {\n                    return Promise.reject(new DOMException('Synthetic camera/microphone acquisition failure', testSettings.cameraAudioErrorName));\n                }\n                return createStream(Boolean(constraints.video), Boolean(constraints.audio));\n            } },\n            getDisplayMedia: { value: (options: DisplayMediaStreamOptions = {}) => {\n                displayRequests.push(options);\n                if (testSettings.displayErrorName) return Promise.reject(new DOMException('Synthetic display capture cancellation', testSettings.displayErrorName));\n                return createStream(true, options.audio !== false).then((stream) => {\n                    const videoTrack = stream.getVideoTracks()[0];\n                    if (testSettings.displayInitiallyMuted) Object.defineProperty(videoTrack, 'muted', { configurable: true, value: true });\n                    return stream;\n                });\n            } },\n            enumerateDevices: { value: () => Promise.resolve([]) },\n        });\n        Object.defineProperty(window, 'showSaveFilePicker', { value: undefined, configurable: true });\n    });\n    await page.goto('/admin/recording-studio');\n    await expect(page.getByRole('button', { name: 'Přidat zdroj', exact: true })).toBeEnabled();\n    expect(await page.evaluate(() => (window as unknown as { studioTestMediaRequests: MediaStreamConstraints[] }).studioTestMediaRequests)).toEqual([]);\n    // Complete the unrelated cookie choice so a moving bottom panel cannot intercept studio controls.\n    const cookiePanel = page.getByRole('region', { name: 'Cookies', exact: true });\n    if (await cookiePanel.count()) {\n        await cookiePanel.getByRole('button').first().click();\n        await page.getByRole('dialog').getByRole('button', { name: /Uložit nastavení|Save settings/ }).click();\n        await expect(cookiePanel).toHaveCount(0);\n    }\n}\n\nasync function readRecordedSeconds(page: Page) {\n    const timecode = await page.getByLabel('Délka záznamu', { exact: true }).textContent();\n    const [hours = NaN, minutes = NaN, seconds = NaN] = (timecode ?? '').split(':').map(Number);\n    return [hours, minutes, seconds].every(Number.isFinite) ? hours * 3_600 + minutes * 60 + seconds : -1;\n}\n\nasync function waitForRecordingSeconds(page: Page, minimumSeconds: number) {\n    await expect.poll(() => readRecordedSeconds(page)).toBeGreaterThanOrEqual(minimumSeconds);\n}\n\nasync function waitForCommittedRecordingSources(page: Page, sourceCount: number) {\n    await expect.poll(() => page.evaluate(async () => {\n        const database = await new Promise<IDBDatabase>((resolve, reject) => {\n            const request = indexedDB.open('promptbook-recording-studio');\n            request.onsuccess = () => resolve(request.result);\n            request.onerror = () => reject(request.error);\n        });\n        try {\n            const recordings = await new Promise<StudioRecording[]>((resolve, reject) => {\n                const request = database.transaction('recordings').objectStore('recordings').getAll();\n                request.onsuccess = () => resolve(request.result);\n                request.onerror = () => reject(request.error);\n            });\n            const activeRecording = recordings.find((recording) => recording.status === 'recording');\n            return activeRecording?.tracks.filter((track) => track.parts?.some((part) => part.byteLength > 0)).length ?? 0;\n        } finally {\n            database.close();\n        }\n    })).toBe(sourceCount);\n}\n\nasync function addSource(page: Page, kind: 'camera' | 'screen' | 'microphone', isAudioEnabled = true) {\n    await page.getByRole('button', { name: 'Přidat zdroj', exact: true }).click();\n    await page.getByLabel('Typ zdroje').selectOption(kind);\n    if (kind === 'screen') {\n        const sourceDialog = Recording, storage, codecs and ZIP are real.\n        const streams: MediaStream[] = [];\n        const mediaRequests: MediaStreamConstraints[] = [];\n        const displayRequests: DisplayMediaStreamOptions[] = [];\n        const testSettings = { cameraAudioErrorName: null as string | null, displayErrorName: null as string | null, displayInitiallyMuted: false };\n        const MARKER_PERIOD_MILLISECONDS = 700;\n        const MARKER_DURATION_SECONDS = 0.24;\n        const MARKER_TIME_ORIGIN = performance.now();\n        Object.assign(window, { studioTestStreams: streams, studioTestMediaRequests: mediaRequests, studioTestDisplayRequests: displayRequests, studioTestSettings: testSettings });\n        const createStream = async (isVideo: boolean, isAudio: boolean) => {\n            const stream = new MediaStream();\n            let audioAnalyser: AnalyserNode | null = null;\n            if (isAudio) {\n                // Render real audio into a captured stream without connecting the fixture oscillator to speakers.\n                const context = new AudioContext();\n                const oscillator = context.createOscillator();\n                const gain = context.createGain();\n                const destination = context.createMediaStreamDestination();\n                gain.gain.value = 0;\n                oscillator.frequency.value = 880;\n                oscillator.connect(gain); gain.connect(destination); oscillator.start();\n                stream.addTrack(destination.stream.getAudioTracks()[0]);\n                // Observe the captured audio after the stream destination. Browser load can delay its samples\n                // relative to the wall clock, so the visual pulse must follow this signal rather than a timer.\n                audioAnalyser = context.createAnalyser();\n                audioAnalyser.fftSize = 256;\n                context.createMediaStreamSource(destination.stream).connect(audioAnalyser);\n                await context.resume();\n                const elapsedSeconds = (performance.now() - MARKER_TIME_ORIGIN) / 1000;\n                const audioTimeAtOrigin = context.currentTime - elapsedSeconds;\n                const nextMarkerIndex = Math.max(0, Math.ceil(elapsedSeconds / (MARKER_PERIOD_MILLISECONDS / 1000)));\n                for (let markerIndex = nextMarkerIndex; markerIndex < 100; markerIndex += 1) {\n                    const markerTime = audioTimeAtOrigin + markerIndex * MARKER_PERIOD_MILLISECONDS / 1000;\n                    if (markerTime < context.currentTime) continue;\n                    gain.gain.setValueAtTime(0.2, markerTime);\n                    gain.gain.setValueAtTime(0, markerTime + MARKER_DURATION_SECONDS);\n                }\n            }\n            if (isVideo) {\n                const canvas = document.createElement('canvas');\n                canvas.width = 320; canvas.height = 180;\n                const context = canvas.getContext('2d')!;\n                const audioLevelSamples = new Float32Array(256);\n                const draw = () => {\n                    let isMarkerVisible: boolean;\n                    if (audioAnalyser) {\n                        audioAnalyser.getFloatTimeDomainData(audioLevelSamples);\n                        isMarkerVisible = audioLevelSamples.some((sample) => Math.abs(sample) > 0.04);\n                    } else {\n                        isMarkerVisible = (performance.now() - MARKER_TIME_ORIGIN) % MARKER_PERIOD_MILLISECONDS < MARKER_DURATION_SECONDS * 1000;\n                    }\n                    context.fillStyle = isMarkerVisible ? '#fff' : '#102030';\n                    context.fillRect(0, 0, 320, 180);\n                    context.fillStyle = '#fff'; context.font = '24px sans-serif';\n                    context.fillText(String(performance.now()), 20, 90);\n                };\n                draw();\n                const interval = setInterval(draw, 33);\n                const videoTrack = canvas.captureStream(30).getVideoTracks()[0];\n                videoTrack.addEventListener('ended', () => clearInterval(interval));\n                stream.addTrack(videoTrack);\n            }\n            streams.push(stream);\n            return stream;\n        };\n        Object.defineProperties(navigator.mediaDevices, {\n            getUserMedia: { value: (constraints: MediaStreamConstraints) createStream(Boolean(constraints.video), Boolean(constraints.audio));\n            } },\n            getDisplayMedia: { value: (options: DisplayMediaStreamOptions = {}) => {\n                displayRequests.push(options);\n                if (testSettings.displayErrorName) return Promise.reject(new DOMException('Synthetic display capture cancellation', testSettings.displayErrorName));\n (testSettings.displayInitiallyMuted) Object.defineProperty(videoTrack, 'muted', { configurable: true, value: true });\n                    return stream;\n                });\n            } },\n test.skip(!process.env.ADMIN_PASSWORD, 'Needs the local test server admin password.');\n    await page.context().addCookies([{ name: ADMIN_SESSION_COOKIE_NAME, value: createAdminSessionValueOrNull()!, url: baseURL!, httpOnly: true, sameSite: 'Lax' }]);\n    await page.addInitScript(() => {\n        // Only replace physical devices/the permission picker. Recording, storage, codecs and ZIP are real.\n        const streams: MediaStream[] = [];\n        const mediaRequests: MediaStreamConstraints[] = [];\n        const displayRequests: DisplayMediaStreamOptions[] = [];\n        const testSettings = { cameraAudioErrorName: null as string | null, displayErrorName: null as string | null, displayInitiallyMuted: false };\n        const MARKER_PERIOD_MILLISECONDS = 700;\n        const MARKER_DURATION_SECONDS = 0.24;\n        const MARKER_TIME_ORIGIN = performance.now();\n        Object.assign(window, { studioTestStreams: streams, studioTestMediaRequests: mediaRequests, studioTestDisplayRequests: displayRequests, studioTestSettings: testSettings });\n        const createStream = async (isVideo: boolean, isAudio: boolean) => {\n            const stream = new MediaStream();\n            let audioAnalyser: AnalyserNode | null = null;\n            if (isAudio) {\n                // Render real audio into a captured stream without connecting the fixture oscillator to speakers.\n                const context = new AudioContext();\n                const oscillator = context.createOscillator();\n                const gain = context.createGain();\n                const destination = context.createMediaStreamDestination();\n                gain.gain.value = 0;\n                oscillator.frequency.value = 880;\n                oscillator.connect(gain); gain.connect(destination); oscillator.start();\n                stream.addTrack(destination.stream.getAudioTracks()[0]);\n                // Observe the captured audio after the stream destination. Browser load can delay its samples\n                // relative to the wall clock, so the visual pulse must follow this signal rather than a timer.\n                audioAnalyser = context.createAnalyser();\n                audioAnalyser.fftSize = 256;\n                context.createMediaStreamSource(destination.stream).connect(audioAnalyser);\n                await context.resume();\n                const elapsedSeconds = (performance.now() - MARKER_TIME_ORIGIN) / 1000;\n                const audioTimeAtOrigin = context.currentTime - elapsedSeconds;\n                const nextMarkerIndex = Math.max(0, Math.ceil(elapsedSeconds / (MARKER_PERIOD_MILLISECONDS / 1000)));\n                for (let markerIndex = nextMarkerIndex; markerIndex < 100; markerIndex += 1) {\n                    const markerTime = audioTimeAtOrigin + markerIndex * MARKER_PERIOD_MILLISECONDS / 1000;\n                    if (markerTime < context.currentTime) continue;\n                    gain.gain.setValueAtTime(0.2, markerTime);\n                    gain.gain.setValueAtTime(0, markerTime + MARKER_DURATION_SECONDS);\n                }\n            }\n            if (isVideo) {\n                const canvas = document.createElement('canvas');\n                canvas.width = 320; canvas.height = 180;\n                const context = canvas.getContext('2d')!;\n                const audioLevelSamples = new Float32Array(256);\n                const draw = () => {\n                    let isMarkerVisible: boolean;\n                    if (audioAnalyser) {\n                        audioAnalyser.getFloatTimeDomainData(audioLevelSamples);\n                        isMarkerVisible = audioLevelSamples.some((sample) => Math.abs(sample) > 0.04);\n                    } else {\n                        isMarkerVisible = (performance.now() - MARKER_TIME_ORIGIN) % MARKER_PERIOD_MILLISECONDS < MARKER_DURATION_SECONDS * 1000;\n                    }\n                    context.fillStyle = isMarkerVisible ? '#fff' : '#102030';\n                    context.fillRect(0, 0, 320, 180);\n                    context.fillStyle = '#fff'; context.font = '24px sans-serif';\n                    context.fillText(String(performance.now()), 20, 90);\n                };\n                draw();\n                const interval = setInterval(draw, 33);\n                const videoTrack = canvas.captureStream(30).getVideoTracks()[0];\n                videoTrack.addEventListener('ended', () => clearInterval(interval));\n                stream.addTrack(videoTrack);\n            }\n            streams.push(stream);\n            return stream;\n        };\n        Object.defineProperties(navigator.mediaDevices, {\n            getUserMedia: { value: (constraints: MediaStreamConstraints) => {\n                mediaRequests.push(constraints);\n                if (testSettings.cameraAudioErrorName && Boolean(constraints.video) && Boolean(constraints.audio)) {\n                    return Promise.reject(new DOMException('Synthetic camera/microphone acquisition failure', testSettings.cameraAudioErrorName));\n                }\n                return createStream(Boolean(constraints.video), Boolean(constraints.audio));\n            } },\n            getDisplayMedia: { value: (options: DisplayMediaStreamOptions = {}) => {\n                displayRequests.push(options);\n                if (testSettings.displayErrorName) return Promise.reject(new DOMException('Synthetic display capture cancellation', testSettings.displayErrorName));\n                return createStream(true, options.audio !== false).then((stream) => {\n                    const videoTrack = stream.getVideoTracks()[0];\n                    if (testSettings.displayInitiallyMuted) Object.defineProperty(videoTrack, 'muted', { configurable: true, value: true });\n                    return stream;\n                });\n            } },\n            enumerateDevices: { value: () => Promise.resolve([]) },\n        });\n        Object.defineProperty(window, 'showSaveFilePicker', { value: undefined, configurable: true });\n    });\n    await page.goto('/admin/recording-studio');\n    await expect(page.getByRole('button', { name: 'Přidat zdroj', exact: true })).toBeEnabled();\n    expect(await page.evaluate(() => (window as unknown as { studioTestMediaRequests: MediaStreamConstraints[] }).studioTestMediaRequests)).toEqual([]);\n    // Complete the unrelated cookie choice so a moving bottom panel cannot intercept studio controls.\n    const cookiePanel = page.getByRole('region', { name: 'Cookies', exact: true });\n    if (await cookiePanel.count()) {\n        await cookiePanel.getByRole('button').first().click();\n        await page.getByRole('dialog').getByRole('button', { name: /Uložit nastavení|Save settings/ }).click();\n        await expect(cookiePanel).toHaveCount(0);\n    }\n}\n\nasync function readRecordedSeconds(page: Page) {\n    const timecode = await page.getByLabel('Délka záznamu', { exact: true }).textContent();\n    const [hours = NaN, minutes = NaN, seconds = NaN] = (timecode ?? '').split(':').map(Number);\n    return [hours, minutes, seconds].every(Number.isFinite) ? hours * 3_600 + minutes * 60 + seconds : -1;\n}\n\nasync function waitForRecordingSeconds(page: Page, minimumSeconds: number) {\n    await expect.poll(() => readRecordedSeconds(page)).toBeGreaterThanOrEqual(minimumSeconds);\n}\n\nasync function waitForCommittedRecordingSources(page: Page, sourceCount: number) {\n    await expect.poll(() => page.evaluate(async () => {\n        const database = await new Promise<IDBDatabase>((resolve, reject) => {\n            const request = indexedDB.open('promptbook-recording-studio');\n            request.onsuccess = () => resolve(request.result);\n            request.onerror = () => reject(request.error);\n        });\n        try {\n            const recordings = await new Promise<StudioRecording[]>((resolve, reject) => {\n                const request = database.transaction('recordings').objectStore('recordings').getAll();\n                request.onsuccess = () => resolve(request.result);\n                request.onerror = () => reject(request.error);\n            });\n            const activeRecording = recordings.find((recording) => recording.status === 'recording');\n            return activeRecording?.tracks.filter((track) => track.parts?.some((part) => part.byteLength > 0)).length ?? 0;\n        } finally {\n            database.close();\n        }\n    })).toBe(sourceCount);\n}\n\nasync function addSource(page: Page, kind: 'camera' | 'screen' | 'microphone', isAudioEnabled = true) {\n    await page.getByRole('button', { name: 'Přidat zdroj', exact: true }).click();\n    await page.getByLabel('Typ zdroje').selectOption(kind);\n    if (kind === 'screen') {\n        const sourceDialog = page.getByRole('dialog');\n        await expect(sourceDialog.getByText('macOS Spaces: okno může v prohlížeči chybět nebo přestat posílat obraz', { exact: true })).toBeVisible();\n        await expect(sourceDialog.getByRole('link', { name: 'Otevřít základní test výběru a průběžného obrazu' })).toBeVisible();\n    }\n    if (kind === 'camera' && !isAudioEnabled) await page.getByLabel('Nahrávat zvuk', { exact: true }).uncheck();\n    await page.getByRole('button', { name: 'Připojit zdroj', exact: true }).click();\n    await expect(page.getByRole('dialog')).toHaveCount(0);\n}\n\nasync function connectPendingSources(page: Page) {\n    const connectButtons = page.getByRole('button', { name: 'Připojit', exact: true });\n    while (await connectButtons.count() > 0) {\n        const sourceCountBeforeConnect = await connectButtons.count();\n        await connectButtons.first().click();\n        await expect(connectButtons).toHaveCount(sourceCountBeforeConnect - 1);\n    }\n}\n\nasync function readArchive(pathname: string) {\n    const reader = new ZipReader(new Uint8ArrayReader(await readFile(pathname)));\n    const entries = await reader.getEntries();\n    const files = new Map<string, Uint8Array>();\n    for (const entry of entries) {\n        if (!entry.directory) files.set(entry.filename, await entry.getData(new Uint8ArrayWriter()));\n    }\n    await reader.close();\n    return files;\n}\n\ntest('requires admin authentication for the recording studio', async ({ page }) => {\n    await page.goto('/admin/recording-studio');\n    await expect(page).toHaveURL(/\\/admin\\/login\\?redirectPath=%2Fadmin%2Frecording-studio/);\n});\n\ntest('requires admin authentication for a stable recording workspace address', async ({ page }) => {\n    await page.goto(EDITOR_FIXTURE_PATH);\n    await expect(page).toHaveURL(/\\/admin\\/login\\?redirectPath=%2Fadmin%2Frecording-studio%2Fsynchronized-fixture/);\n});\n\ntest('requires admin authentication before accepting browser-local transcription 'audio/wav', buffer: Buffer.from('untrusted') } },\n    });\n    expect(response.status()).toBe(401);\n});\n\ntest('persists reviewed workshop annotations and rebases them beside every prepared source', async ({ page, baseURL }, testInfo) => {\n    await openStudio(page, baseURL);\n    await seedRecordingEditorFixture(page);\n    const editor = page.getByRole('region', { name: 'Metadata workshopu' });\n    await editor.getByRole('button', { name: 'Založit metadata workshopu' }).click();\n    await editor.getByRole('checkbox', { name: 'Výchozí scénu jsem zkontroloval(a)' }).check();\n request.onerror = () => reject(request.error);\n        });\n        const recording = await new Promise<import('@/lib/recording-studio/recordingStudioTypes').StudioRecording>((resolve, reject) => {\n request.onerror = () => reject(request.error);\n        });\n        database.close();\n        return recording.workshopMetadata?.events[0]?.title ?? null;\n    })).toBe('Agent finished the first testInfo.outputPath('workshop-metadata.zip');\n    await (await downloadPromise).saveAs(archivePath);\n    const files = await readArchive(archivePath);\n    const manifest = JSON.parse(new Every failure — including a stopped, crashed or out-of-space recording — goes through one\n  channel which shows it on the source card and the page, plays an alert sound and posts a browser notification, so\n  an administrator working in the very application being recorded is told without watching the studio tab. A take which lost a\n  source is saved as interrupted and names every source it lost.\n\n- Added a shared-clock participant player for hosted workshop recordings with Auto/Editor/Aplikace/Kamera views,","originalFile":"# Current preversion\n\n- Added a shared-clock participant player for hosted workshop recordings with Auto/Editor/Aplikace/Kamera views,\n  camera picture-in-picture, one audible track, event and activity timeline, manual speed and reviewed automatic\n  coding intervals at up to 10×. The existing repository graph highlights the verified anchored SHA at the playhead.\n  Free live viewers receive only the independently remuxed, at-most-two-second segment at the server-delayed playhead; full media byte ranges,\n  past and future segments remain server-gated, while members can seek the complete published recording. The existing\n  YouTube stage, supplementary placement, wrap-up and paid replay offer remain in use. Slow decoders make accelerated\n  navigation wait for a decoded frame rather than desynchronize the tracks. Delivery and publication limits are in\n  `docs/workshop-hosted-player.md`.\n\n- Added private, synchronized hosted recordings for workshop video: direct independent file/sidecar import and a\n  studio **Publish to workshop** action share resumable SHA-256 checked multipart S3 uploads. Schema 5 manifests,\n  prepared timing, codecs, optional metadata and subtitles are verified before an atomic revision switch. Admins get\n  an error report and preview; incomplete files never replace the published revision. Participant requests for the\n  manifest and every media byte range recheck room access and the existing live/free versus paid replay rule. A\n  connected viewer keeps one immutable revision during replacement; abandoned uploads and old revisions have guarded\n  cleanup. Verified unpublished revisions can be resumed for publication after a reload; draft files can be replaced.\n  Existing YouTube settings, teaser, offset and stage choice remain available when switching sources.\n\n- Added browser-local workshop player metadata to the synchronized recording editor: reviewed activity intervals,\n  independent event markers, validated Auto-view scene choices, repository/start SHA and reviewed commit anchors.\n  Speech suggests boundaries only; unclassified gaps stay at 1× and never become automatic coding from silence.\n  Git timestamp proposals require an explicit wall-clock/session calibration and verification against selected branches;\n  confirmed missing SHA references report unavailable, while failed GitHub checks remain unknown. Manual edits survive\n  derived-track regeneration, appended takes and selected-directory reloads; scene validation checks actual video.\n  Manifest schema 5 and original/prepared JSON sidecars use the shared IN/OUT recipe, retain original coordinates and\n  report stale source revisions. This is local metadata for a later player, not published media or visible transcript\n  subtitles. Design and limits are documented in `docs/recording-studio-workshop-metadata.md`.\n\n- Added independent browser-local subtitle and speech-activity revisions to the synchronized recording editor.\n  A finished camera/screen audio stream or standalone microphone is selected for each explicit request; older\n  recordings locally verify actual audio before enabling a source. Czech,\n  English and mixed subtitles reuse the authenticated OpenAI transcription route, while local Silero VAD produces\n  speech, silence, uncertain and unavailable intervals without invented confidence. Overlapping subtitle chunks\n  reconcile matching suggestions while keeping cues recognized by only one chunk. Shared session timing survives\n  offsets, pauses and appended takes. Editable lanes, autosave, undo, progress/cancel/retry and stale-revision labels\n  preserve corrected captions and original media. ZIP and individual source exports include UTF-8 SRT/WebVTT and\n  activity JSON/CSV beside source files, with prepared metadata clipped and rebased to the same IN/OUT as prepared\n  media. Manifest schema 4 distinguishes original and prepared coordinates. Implementation analysis, formats and\n  platform verification limits are in `docs/recording-studio-derived-tracks.md`.\n\n- Extended the shared recording workspace with a persistent live monitor (grid, focused source, pinned source,\n  optional tile hiding/minimizing, preview sound and camera mirroring). Those display settings never change armed\n  capture sources or raw files. A single guarded Pause/Resume closes every source into independently playable,\n  durably checkpointed parts and resumes them on a recorded-content clock without paused wall time. Failed\n  restart, device loss or storage failure interrupts the entire take and retains committed parts. Editing now has\n  **Donahrát do tohoto projektu**: it restores the intended sources, waits for renewed permissions and explicit\n  Start, then appends a new take under the same recording ID. Old media and edits remain; an untouched full range\n  extends while a custom trim remains fixed. ZIP manifests carry take/part identities, timing and real source gaps.\n  Closed parts carry measured encoded bounds and their own camera audio/video settings; shorter tails and older\n  single-file timeline gaps remain explicit. Source reuse for a different new recording remains a separate action. Design and verification evidence are in\n  `docs/recording-studio-monitoring-pause-append.md`.\n\n- Replaced the recording-detail modal with an authenticated preparation workspace at\n  `/admin/recording-studio/<recordingId>`, reusing the studio shell, browser lock, stable IDs and local media.\n  All camera, screen and audio sources now share a zoomable timeline, decoded thumbnails/sparse audio samples,\n  playhead and coordinated play/pause/seek/speed controls. Offset/segment mappings retain gaps and short sources;\n  playback waits for decoder starts, pausing/revealing a source settles its decoded frame, and decoder failures\n  hide stale frames and can be retried. Visual hide/solo and audio mute/solo only affect monitoring,\n  with one audible source initially; every source remains in exports. A common draggable IN/OUT range, precise\n  seconds, undo/reset and protected autosave persist a versioned recipe without changing original bytes. ZIP64\n  and individual-file exports preserve separate sources and embedded audio, include explicit source/session/export\n  timing, record video resampling to the source's nominal cadence, and validate transcoded boundaries within 50 ms\n  per component, including long final frames. Unsupported or discontinuous sources are\n  clearly labelled originals plus recipe. Cancellation/retry preserves originals; export holds the selected edit\n  steady and preserves incomplete trim drafts. Small individual prepared downloads survive temporary-file cleanup;\n  larger ones require direct disk saving instead of an unbounded memory copy. Legacy metadata and directory\n  checkpoints retain their IDs and saved selections, and deep links explain\n  absent local data. Added deterministic timecode/clap, late-session, failure/recovery and external FFmpeg checks;\n  verification details and unavailable macOS/physical-device tests are recorded in `docs/recording-studio-editor.md`.\n\n- Investigated the missing VS Code window reported on another macOS Space. The studio's shared capture path does not\n  enumerate or filter system windows; its optional `displaySurface` value is a type preference, and the browser/OS\n  owns the chooser.
